evidence: The Croesus Track crosses the Paparoa Range between Blackball in the Grey Valley and Barrytown on the Tasman Sea Coast.
It's recommended to walk from Smoke-ho carpark in the east to Barrytown in the west.
Go up this gravel road to Smoke-ho car park and to the start of Croesus Track.
For the last 2 hours, 30 minutes the track is marked down the ridge.

doubts: Start: the text says Smoke-ho car park, reached by Croesus Track Road from Blackball; no road-end feature clearly matches it (F1 is an unnamed track on Blackball Road, which the text does not mention), so the start ref is null. End: 'Barrytown' is the end; F2, where the Croesus Track meets Coast Road, is at Barrytown, so I used it. Shape: one_way from DOC's 'one way' times and the Smoke-ho to Barrytown description. The text recommends walking east to west but does not say the reverse is a separate way, so no direction is given. The Garden Gully junction is named as where the Garden Gully side trip leaves the Croesus Track, but its position along the way is not stated, so it is not placed in via. The Battery Track turn-off is a junction the way passes before Ces Clark Hut. Croesus Top Hut is passed but cannot be stayed in; it is listed in huts since the way passes it, with no feature or link ref. The ridge entry in via has no name in the text.
